title: Pamela fails her trust test while about 70 scout craft watch
place_text: Indian Springs Valley, Nevada (ranges near the ammunition bunker)

tellings.quote: Okay. On that night, on that night, she failed the test.

plain: Sometime between 1965 and 1967, in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, out on the ranges near an ammunition bunker, a figure named Pamela took a test of trust and failed it while about 70 scout craft watched. Charles Hall, who says he spent three years among tall white aliens at Area 51, tells Michels he was there, and says simply: "On that night, she failed the test." If it happened, it would mean those beings test the people around them and come out in force to watch.
